findings.description: ECE people page downloaded 2026-11-25T02:24:11Z (sha256 d0a4025c...). Parsed 71 person entries under 15 section headings; 63 distinct names, exactly matching brief.people (no omissions, no extras). Each brief person appears once in records.
No incoming, courtesy, or affiliate/below-the-line designation appears on the list page. No incoming subtotal; no announced start dates; effective_from_json is null for all records.
Profile pages fetched (https) for Misra, Dhawan, Kam and Ziavras only, for the ambiguous rank questions. Other persons are decided from list-page headings and titles; their profiles were not fetched.

Staff excluded per brief: Chen and Mathes (also under Adjunct), Bass, Faltz, Sylla-Samassa, Virgin, Benjamin, Gregory, Hernandez, Pierre. Liu, Xuan is included as Professor despite the Advisors listing.

Included as regular. The list page places him under Distinguished Professors (title: Chief Strategic Innovation Officer, Office of the President) and his profile states "Dr. Dhawan is a Distinguished Professor", which supplies the professorial rank the brief requires. Outcome would change to excluded (academic_professional) if the ECE department listing were not accepted as an EE/ECE professorial designation; the profile lists ECE courses, supporting that designation.

Included as regular (re-decided after coordinator review of downloads). Basis: the ECE department people page files him under the Distinguished Professors heading; the downloaded profile states only the administrative title Interim Provost and EVP for Academic Affairs and contains no non-professorial, retired, or emeritus statement. Would change to excluded (academic_professional) if an official page states he has no professorial appointment.

Included as regular (re-decided after coordinator review of downloads). Basis: the ECE department people page files him under the Professors heading; the downloaded profile states only the administrative titles V Prov Grad Stud/Dean Grad Fac and Senior Vice Provost for Academic Affairs and contains no non-professorial, retired, or emeritus statement. Would change to excluded (academic_professional) if an official page states he has no professorial appointment.
Included as regular (Chair). Profile confirms "Full Professor and the Department Chair in Electrical and Computer Engineering".

Joint_secondary group (Abichandani, Azizi, Li, Pal): each has a professorial rank on the Joint Appointments listing (Associate Professor or Professor) and no home department. Included once each; regular-versus-courtesy subtype not stated, so joint_secondary is recorded.
Adjunct group (9 people): titles "Adjunct" or "Adjunct Instructor". Excluded as adjunct. Adjunct Instructor titles also carry the teaching title; the decision is the same under either category.
